# BOX-LQ1 P0/P1 local acceptance — 2026-10-13

**Decision: GO_TO_HUMAN_PILOT (ontology clarity only).** The owner may make genuine subjective judgments in the authenticated local v1.1 human route. No human label has been generated by Codex, no reliability statistic or market-wide recall is available, and no real-label model training has been run. This branch is stacked on unmerged PR #21; it is **not** a main-release receipt.

## Scope delivered

- P0 read-only baseline/gap inventory: [box-lq1-p0-gap-audit-2026-10-13.md](box-lq1-p0-gap-audit-2026-10-13.md).
- Version `box-structure-label-v1.1` with BOX / NOT_BOX / UNCERTAIN, conditional position, subtype, confidence, optional reasons/note, optional daily evidence start and paired relative-percent box boundaries. Invalid combinations, fields, numbers, versions and stale revisions are rejected. The [handbook](../../docs/BOX_LABELING_V1_1.md) specifies null and coordinate semantics.
- Additive `annotations-v1.1-human.sqlite3` and `annotations-v1.1-smoke.sqlite3` namespaces. The old v1 annotation schema and files were not migrated or rewritten. The v1.1 chart adds relative-percent scale labels using verified private as-of-T raw history; no absolute price, ticker, date or score is placed in the visible payload.
- Authenticated `/box-label/v1.1/<human|smoke>/` page uses existing Label Studio login, CSRF and same-origin routes. Save, revision/edit, skip, undo, refresh persistence and navigation were checked. No new public endpoint or Sites publication.
- A **design-only** 180-task future pool config at [box_labeling_v11_sampling.yaml](../../config/box_labeling_v11_sampling.yaml), targeting 40% permissive positives, 30% near misses, 30% truly unconditional controls. This pool has **not** been generated because verified issuer grouping and full eligible denominators have not been established. No inclusion probability is invented from the old capped pool.

## Real local data / isolation

The existing immutable private v1 task batch supplies the pilot charts: 30 tasks / 30 distinct security IDs, Train 21 / Validation 9, positive 21 / boundary 6 / control 3. Years 2022/2023/2024/2025: 8/8/7/7. Membership confirmed 23 / probable 7. Full 48-month history exists for 6/30; actual observed coverage appears on every page. The private receipt states `box-label-tasks-v1`, manifest SHA-256 `a48d701967e765846233af4a8987ccde28b2842c77a8eada942a2725c6e8425d` and RI semantic hash `74b765911a8a4f18b2074cd8d9e529b25b54afade15309a148b0ca43340b80be`. It scanned a capped 1,800-row ordered pool but recorded only 27 positive and 7 boundary candidate evaluations before quota completion. This is not a known-probability market-wide draw.

After browser smoke, private SQLite counts were: old v1 human **0 revisions / 0 events**, old v1 smoke **4 revisions / 1 event**, v1.1 smoke **3 revisions / 1 event**. The v1.1 human database did not exist because the formal human route was never used. Smoke labels are synthetic engineering inputs, not human Ground Truth. No private chart, manifest, identity map, label DB or screenshot is committed.

## Browser evidence

The actual local Label Studio-backed service on `localhost:8124` served the new smoke page under an existing authenticated session. The page displayed daily/weekly/monthly chart images and the v1.1 controls. Ten distinct tasks (positions 4–13) each loaded all three real 960-pixel SVGs, including partial weekly/monthly coverage such as 33/52 weekly and 7/48 monthly; none displayed candidate score or identity. The smoke route exercised NOT_BOX, UNCERTAIN and BOX, position/subtype/confidence, a reason, note, start ordinal and paired boundaries. It saved, reopened, revised, skipped, undid an unsaved edit and reloaded persisted state. The first saved revision was visibly restored with the original note and three images after refresh. The UI automatically advances to the first unsaved task on reload, so returning to a saved task requires Previous or navigation; this is documented workflow behavior.

## Automated gates

- Targeted v1.1 plus v1 tests: **11 passed, 1 skipped** (private batch absent from this new worktree; separately read from sibling private path).
- Full repository pytest using the existing local virtual environment: **722 passed, 18 skipped, 1 warning**, 58.12 seconds. The warning is the installed `websockets.legacy` deprecation warning. Tests cover causal future mutation, as-of-T partial bars, hash gates, blind payload, conditional choices, null boundaries, v1/v1.1 and human/smoke separation, and version/revision conflicts. The parent PR #21 observed-length mask repair remains in this code path and was not reimplemented.
- Native LEAN / QC Cloud: **not run**, outside BOX-LQ1 P0/P1 and not relevant to human measurement validity.

## Limits / next gate

The 30-task v1 pool has only three controls and no hidden repeats; it cannot measure false-negative recall or within-rater agreement. Later-disappeared issuer participation and alias continuity remain unproved by this manifest. A separate v1.1 180-task pool requires verified issuer grouping and eligible denominators, plus an actual task-builder implementation in a later authorized stage. The current v1.1 pilot can establish whether the ontology is usable; only the owner can supply real labels. If genuine cases repeatedly lack defensible boundaries or categories, return to **REDEFINE_ONTOLOGY** before any supervised model. No P2 detector expansion, future-return study, Test/Fresh selection or substantive training follows from this acceptance.
